mapper.update:
update ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together
shop_id = #{param.shopId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
user_id = #{param.userId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
name = #{param.name,jdbcType=VARCHAR},
person_num = #{param.personNum,jdbcType=INTEGER},
start_time = #{param.startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
end_time = #{param.endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
created_time = #{param.createdTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
update_time = #{param.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},
status = #{param.status,jdbcType=BIT},
common_id = #{param.commonId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
start_hour = #{param.startHour,jdbcType=INTEGER},
where pintuan_id = #{param.pintuanId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

update ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail
pintuan_id = #{param.pintuanId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
goods_id = #{param.goodsId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
price_ori = #{param.priceOri,jdbcType=REAL},
price = #{param.price,jdbcType=REAL},
price_one = #{param.priceOne,jdbcType=REAL},
cid = #{param.cid,jdbcType=INTEGER},
common_id = #{param.commonId,jdbcType=INTEGER},
where detail_id = #{param.detailId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
mapper.select: select pp.pintuan_id, pp.person_num, pp.start_time, pp.end_time, pd.detail_id, pd.price, pd.price_one, pp.status from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd ON pp.pintuan_id = pd.pintuan_id where pp.status = 1 and pp.common_id = #{commonId} and pd.goods_id = #{goodsId}

SELECT pd.detail_id, pp.pintuan_id, pp.person_num, pd.goods_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd ON pd.pintuan_id = pp.pintuan_id WHERE pp.`status` = 1 and (NOW() BETWEEN pp.start_time AND pp.end_time) and pd.common_id = #{commonId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and pd.goods_id = #{goodsId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

SELECT pp.pintuan_id, pm.detail_id, pm.mark_id, pm.num, pm.surplus_num, pp.person_num, pm.status FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark pm LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd ON pm.detail_id = pd.detail_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp ON pp.pintuan_id = pd.pintuan_id WHERE pm.mark_id = #{markId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND pm.status = 0

select gc.common_name as commonName,gc.common_id as commonId,gc.goods_id as goodsId,gc.common_image as commonImage,gc.shop_id as shopId,gc.shop_name as shopName, gc.common_price as commonPrice ,pd.price as activityPrice,gc.common_evaluate as commonEvaluate,gc.common_salenum as commonSalenum,date_format(pp.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as startTime,date_format(pp.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as endTime from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd on pp.pintuan_id = pd.pintuan_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on pd.common_id = gc.common_id where pp.status = 1
and pd.price >= #{param.minPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
and pd.price <= #{param.maxPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}
GROUP BY pd.common_id
ORDER BY gc.common_salenum DESC, pd.price ASC, gc.common_add_time DESC
ORDER BY gc.common_evaluate DESC
ORDER BY gc.common_evaluate ASC
ORDER BY pd.price desc
ORDER BY pd.price ASC
ORDER BY gc.common_salenum desc
ORDER BY gc.common_salenum asc

SELECT gp.NAME AS NAME, gp.person_num AS personNum, gp.common_id AS commonId, gd.price_ori AS priceOri, gd.price AS price, gc.common_image AS commonImage, gc.common_name AS commonName, gd.goods_id AS goodsId, gp.start_time AS startTime, gp.end_time AS endTime FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together gp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail gd ON gp.pintuan_id = gd.pintuan_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gp.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND gp.STATUS = 1
and gc.goods_type = 3 and gc.shop_id = #{param.shopId}
and gc.goods_type != 3
group by gp.common_id order by gp.update_time desc

SELECT gp.NAME AS NAME, gp.common_id AS commonId, gc.common_image AS commonImage, gc.common_name AS commonName, gd.goods_id AS goodsId, gd.price AS price, gd.price_one AS priceOri FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together gp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail gd ON gp.pintuan_id = gd.pintuan_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gp.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND gp.STATUS = 1 AND end_time > now() AND gc.goods_type != 3
and gp.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.name},'%')
and gc.common_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.commonName},'%')
group by gd.common_id

SELECT gp.NAME AS NAME, gp.person_num AS personNum, gp.common_id AS commonId, gd.price_ori AS priceOri, gd.price AS price, gc.common_image AS commonImage, gc.common_name AS commonName, gd.goods_id AS goodsId, gp.start_time AS startTime, gp.end_time AS endTime FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together gp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail gd ON gp.pintuan_id = gd.pintuan_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gp.common_id = gc.common_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND gp.common_id = #{commonid} group by gp.common_id

select pp.pintuan_id,pp.shop_id,pp.`name`,pp.person_num,pp.start_time,pp.end_time,pp.start_hour,pd.goods_id, pp.`status`,pd.price_ori,pd.price,pd.price_one,pp.update_time,pp.created_time,sb.shop_name,pp.display_order from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd on pp.pintuan_id = pd.pintuan_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.business}hou_shop_base sb on sb.supplier_shop_id = pp.shop_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb on gb.goods_id = pd.goods_id where 1 = 1
and status = #{param.status,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.name},'%')
and shop_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.shopName},'%')
group by pp.pintuan_id ORDER BY display_order desc,update_time desc

select pintuan_id as activity_id,name as activity_name, DATE_FORMAT(end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') as end_time, '正常' as state_label from ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together gp WHERE 1 = 1
and gp.pintuan_id = #{pinTuanId}

SELECT distinct pb.user_id, pb.user_name, pb.user_avatar, pt.pay_start FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_buyer pb LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_temp pt on pb.mark_id = pt.mark_id where pb.mark_id = #{markId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY created_time ASC

SELECT pm.mark_id, pm.user_name as markUserName, pm.created_time, gc.common_name, pp.start_hour, pm.surplus_num, pm.mark_id, pp.end_time FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_mark pm LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together_detail pd ON pm.detail_id = pd.detail_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gc.common_id = pd.common_id LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together pp ON pp.pintuan_id = pd.pintuan_id WHERE ( now() BETWEEN pp.start_time AND pp.end_time ) AND pm.STATUS = 0 and pm.mark_id = #{param.markId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY created_time asc
SELECT pintuan_id FROM ${database.prefix.activity}hou_addon_activity_piecing_together WHERE `status` = 1 AND (NOW() BETWEEN start_time AND end_time) AND common_id = #{commonId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
